text:
{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system appears to interpret past interactions as continuing interest in broadly related products or content, with insufficient attention to the specific purpose of the next choice.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they support a concrete next step using existing purchases or extend an established compatible setup.",
    "Content recommendations align when they preserve a specific artist, sound, or combination of interests supported by recent and repeated interactions."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related items compete with stronger matches despite requiring equipment, projects, or interests that the history does not establish.",
    "Recommendations repeat recently satisfied durable-device needs and treat older or isolated interactions as evidence of current demand.",
    "Weakly supported content connections produce recommendations whose relevance cannot be established from the identifiable history; uncertain matches should not be interpreted as demonstrated dislikes."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Broad product families, shared terminology, musical eras, and general content similarities substitute for matching the purpose or experience users seek.",
    "Ownership of one product or enjoyment of one title is extended into interest in adjacent devices, supplies, or styles without sufficient supporting behavior."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Practical fit depends on compatibility, dimensions, connection types, installation requirements, and a concrete use with existing equipment.",
    "Recent direction and repeated specific interests matter more than isolated historical purchases or broad category membership.",
    "Complementary additions, already satisfied needs, and replacements represent different reasons to choose an item.",
    "Content choices depend on specific combinations of story, tone, artist, instrumentation, and listening experience."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Broad relevance appears sufficient for high ranking even when an item lacks a supported current use or specific experiential match, leaving too few immediately compelling choices.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "Measure the share of top-ranked recommendations users would choose now, distinguishing immediate choices from general appeal, conditional usefulness, and uncertainty.",
    "Track how often top-ranked items require unsupported equipment or projects, duplicate recently satisfied needs, or fail stated compatibility requirements.",
    "Compare immediate-choice acceptance for recommendations tied to recent specific interests with those supported only by broad historical similarity.",
    "Track unassessable recommendations separately from explicit mismatches, particularly where item identity or historical content is unavailable."
  ]
}
